full_page.content:
1946, May 20th
The following is a faithful transcription of a photo copy of a brief message on a Seraphic Mass Association Card by the Ser- vant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
Mrs. Catherine Ravine - for speedy recovery, God willing . May 20th - 1946
God bless you Mrs. Ravine Do not worry too much. We'll pray and trust in God. Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap.
The Original in possession of: Mrs. Catherine Ravine 9182 Bishop Detroit, Michigan 48224
